selection.rule: Homepage events come from current RSS/advisory sources. CVEs are shown only when the source article/advisory mentions them.

items.title: DIVD says Zammad zero-days enabled AI-driven network breach
items.summary: The Dutch Institute for Vulnerability Disclosure (DIVD) says that the breach of its network was possible by exploiting a chain of two zero-day vulnerabilities in the open-source Zammad ticketing system. [...]
items.title_zh: DIVD 表示 Zammad 零日漏洞導致 AI 驅動的網路入侵
items.summary_zh: 荷蘭漏洞披露研究所（DIVD）表示，攻擊者透過利用開源 Zammad 工單系統中的兩個零日漏洞鏈，入侵了其網路。[...]

items.title: Cisco warns of new SD-WAN zero-day exploited in attacks
items.summary: Cisco released security updates to address a critical zero-day in the Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (tracked as CVE-2026-76504) that attackers are actively exploiting to escalate to admin privileges. [...]
items.title_zh: 思科針對已被利用於攻擊的新 SD-WAN 零日漏洞發出警告
items.summary_zh: 思科發布了安全性更新，以修復 Catalyst SD-WAN Manager 中的一個嚴重零日漏洞（追蹤為 CVE-2026-76504），攻擊者目前正積極利用該漏洞來提升至管理員權限。[...]

items.title: Government, Finance Orgs Targeted in Weeks-Long NetScaler Zero-Day Attacks
items.summary: Several security firms have confirmed seeing exploitation of the NetScaler vulnerabilities CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772. The post Government, Finance Orgs Targeted in Weeks-Long NetScaler Zero-Day Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 政府與金融機構成為持續數週的 NetScaler 零日漏洞攻擊目標
items.summary_zh: 多家安全公司已確認觀察到針對 NetScaler 漏洞 CVE-2026-88771 與 CVE-2026-88772 的利用行為。這篇「Government, Finance Orgs Targeted in Weeks-Long NetScaler Zero-Day Attacks」文章首先發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Bitget hacked via zero-day in third-party security products
items.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget revealed today that attackers who stole $387.5 million last week breached its systems after exploiting a zero-day flaw in third-party security products. [...]
items.title_zh: Bitget 因第三方安全產品中的零日漏洞遭駭
items.summary_zh: 加密貨幣交易所 Bitget 今日透露，上週盜走 3.875 億美元的攻擊者，是在利用了第三方安全產品中的零日漏洞後入侵其系統的。[...]

items.title: Hackers exploit Citrix NetScaler zero-day to deploy web shells
items.summary: Cybersecurity firms say attackers exploited the Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-88772 zero-day to deploy custom web shells and tunneling malware, gain root access, steal credentials, and spread into internal networks. [...]
